name: Repair a broken roadmap wrapper import: the preserved .claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md points at a command body this project does not have, so a removal notice is written there (an existing local roadmap command is left untouched and keeps working)

content: `/awos:roadmap` was removed in AWOS 2.0. AWOS is not a planning or backlog tool: specs are anchored by an explicit topic now, not by a roadmap item. (This notice was written because your preserved command wrapper pointed at a file this project did not have — there was no local copy of the old command to keep working.)
Tell the user the following, then stop. Do not build, update, or review a roadmap document.
- This command no longer ships with AWOS. To start a feature, run `/awos:spec` and state the topic directly.
- If `context/product/roadmap.md` exists, it is theirs to keep or delete — AWOS no longer creates or updates it, but while it exists, `/awos:spec` offers its incomplete items as topic candidates.
- To remove this notice, delete `.claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md` and `.awos/commands/roadmap.md`.
